import base64, ctypes as c, io, os, shutil, subprocess, time
from pathlib import Path
from pywinauto import Desktop
from pywinauto.keyboard import send_keys
import psutil
from PIL import Image

ROOT=Path(r"C:\dev\flyExplorer")
EXE=ROOT/"out"/"winui"/"Release"/"flyExplorer.exe"
profile=Path(os.environ["USERPROFILE"])
aliases={
"Desktop":("Desktop","\ubc14\ud0d5 \ud654\uba74"),
"Documents":("Documents","\ubb38\uc11c"),
"Downloads":("Downloads","\ub2e4\uc6b4\ub85c\ub4dc"),
"Pictures":("Pictures","\uc0ac\uc9c4"),
"Music":("Music","\uc74c\uc545"),
"Videos":("Videos","\ub3d9\uc601\uc0c1"),
}
targets=tuple(aliases)

def until(fn,why,timeout=25):
    end=time.monotonic()+timeout
    last=None
    while time.monotonic()<end:
        try:
            v=fn()
            if v:return v
        except Exception as e:last=e
        time.sleep(.22)
    raise AssertionError(why+(f" ({last!r})" if last else ""))

def shot(wrapper):
    img=wrapper.capture_as_image().convert("RGB")
    img.thumbnail((972,720))
    b=io.BytesIO();img.save(b,format="JPEG",quality=86,optimize=True)
    return base64.b64encode(b.getvalue()).decode("ascii")

def key_for_name(name):
    for key,names in aliases.items():
        if any(alias in name for alias in names):return key
    return None

def find_in(container,key):
    for x in container.descendants():
        if x.element_info.control_type!="ListItem":continue
        try:name=x.element_info.name or x.window_text()
        except Exception:continue
        if key_for_name(name)==key:return x,name
    return None

def materialize(container,key,image_name=None):
    pair=until(lambda:find_in(container,key),f"{key} row absent")
    try:pair[0].scroll_into_view()
    except Exception:pass
    time.sleep(.45)
    def ready():
        pair=find_in(container,key)
        if not pair:return None
        row,name=pair
        r=row.rectangle()
        if r.width()<=0 or r.height()<=0:return None
        if image_name is None:return pair
        imgs=[x for x in row.descendants()
              if x.element_info.control_type=="Image" and x.element_info.name==image_name]
        if len(imgs)!=1:return None
        ir=imgs[0].rectangle()
        if ir.width()<=0 or ir.height()<=0:return None
        return row,name,imgs[0]
    return until(ready,f"{key} did not materialize")

owned=ROOT/"logs"/"known-folder-artwork-owned"
if owned.exists():shutil.rmtree(owned)
(owned/"localappdata"/"flyExplorer").mkdir(parents=True)
(owned/"appdata").mkdir();(owned/"temp").mkdir()
(owned/"localappdata"/"flyExplorer"/"ui-preferences-v1.txt").write_text(
 "schema=2\r\nlanguage=ko-KR\r\ntheme=dark\r\nview=large-icons\r\n",
 encoding="ascii",newline="")
env=os.environ.copy()
env["LOCALAPPDATA"]=str(owned/"localappdata");env["APPDATA"]=str(owned/"appdata")
env["TEMP"]=env["TMP"]=str(owned/"temp")

app=subprocess.Popen([str(EXE),str(profile)],cwd=EXE.parent,env=env)
appw=None
try:
    def app_window():
        if app.poll() is not None:return None
        ws=[w for w in Desktop(backend="uia").windows(process=app.pid)
            if "flyExplorer" in w.window_text()]
        return ws[0] if len(ws)==1 else None
    appw=until(app_window,"flyExplorer window missing")
    try:appw.move_window(x=40,y=40,width=972,height=720,repaint=True)
    except Exception:pass
    files=until(lambda:next((x for x in appw.descendants()
                  if x.element_info.automation_id=="LeftFiles"),None),"LeftFiles missing")
    results={}
    for key in targets:
        row,name,img=materialize(files,key,"Windows Known Folder artwork")
        r=row.rectangle();ir=img.rectangle()
        results[key]=(name,(r.left,r.top,r.width(),r.height()),
                      (ir.left,ir.top,ir.width(),ir.height()))
        print("FLY_KNOWN_FOLDER_ROW",key,repr(name),
              "ROW",results[key][1],"IMAGE",results[key][2],flush=True)
    # Center visual evidence around Desktop after all six functional checks.
    materialize(files,"Desktop","Windows Known Folder artwork")
    time.sleep(.7)
    print("FLY_KNOWN_FOLDER_COUNT",len(results),flush=True)
    print("FLY_SCREENSHOT_BEGIN",flush=True);print(shot(appw),flush=True);print("FLY_SCREENSHOT_END",flush=True)
finally:
    if app.poll() is None:
        if appw:
            c.windll.user32.PostMessageW(appw.handle,0x10,0,0)
            try:app.wait(timeout=10)
            except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:app.terminate();app.wait(timeout=8)
        else:app.terminate();app.wait(timeout=8)
print("FLY_PROCESS_EXIT",app.returncode,flush=True)

before=set()
for w in Desktop(backend="uia").windows(control_type="Window"):
    try:
        if psutil.Process(w.element_info.process_id).name().lower()=="explorer.exe":
            before.add(w.handle)
    except Exception:pass
subprocess.Popen(["explorer.exe","/separate,",str(profile)])
exp=None
try:
    def exp_window():
        for w in Desktop(backend="uia").windows(control_type="Window"):
            try:
                if w.handle in before:continue
                if psutil.Process(w.element_info.process_id).name().lower()=="explorer.exe":return w
            except Exception:pass
        return None
    exp=until(exp_window,"Explorer window missing",20)
    try:exp.move_window(x=40,y=40,width=972,height=720,repaint=True)
    except Exception:pass
    exp.set_focus();send_keys("^+2");time.sleep(1.3)
    eresults={}
    for key in targets:
        row,name=materialize(exp,key,None)
        r=row.rectangle()
        eresults[key]=(name,(r.left,r.top,r.width(),r.height()))
        print("EXPLORER_KNOWN_FOLDER_ROW",key,repr(name),
              "ROW",eresults[key][1],flush=True)
    materialize(exp,"Desktop",None)
    time.sleep(.7)
    print("EXPLORER_KNOWN_FOLDER_COUNT",len(eresults),flush=True)
    print("EXPLORER_SCREENSHOT_BEGIN",flush=True);print(shot(exp),flush=True);print("EXPLORER_SCREENSHOT_END",flush=True)
finally:
    if exp:
        try:exp.close()
        except Exception:pass
